// CASE swift_top_let_vs_property_implicit_self expect=pass
let width = 1
struct Importer {
  let width: Int
  func run(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save)
  }
}
// CASE swift_top_let_vs_local_var expect=pass
let limit = 1
func localVar(_ items: [Int], _ config: Config) async throws {
  var limit = config.limit
  limit += 1
  try await mapWithConcurrency(items, limit, save)
}
// CASE swift_top_let_vs_guard_let expect=pass
let concurrency = 1
func guardLet(_ items: [Int], _ config: Config) async throws {
  guard let concurrency = config.concurrency else { return }
  try await mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, save)
}
// CASE end expect=pass
